seo.title: Beheader Web — Local Polyglot File Generator
seo.description: Combine supported images, audio or video, HTML, PDFs and archives into one polyglot file. Files stay on your device. Free and offline-capable.
seo.imageAlt: Beheader Web icon: a square tile combining an image and text

hero.title: One file. Many possibilities.
hero.description: Combine different files into one. Change the extension. See another side.
hero.privacy: Your files stay on your device
hero.guideDescription: A polyglot is one file that works as several formats.
hero.stepChoose: Choose at least two file types.
hero.stepDownload: Download and open with a compatible app.

diagnostic.INVALID_REQUEST: The selection is invalid. Remove the affected file and select it again.
diagnostic.INVALID_SIZE: Invalid file size. Select a valid local file.
diagnostic.INPUT_TOO_LARGE: Each input must be at most 1 GiB. Choose a smaller file.
diagnostic.TOTAL_TOO_LARGE: Inputs exceed 2 GiB in total. Remove or replace files.
diagnostic.INPUT_EMPTY: An input is empty. Remove it or choose a nonempty file.
diagnostic.INPUT_UNKNOWN: File type not recognized. Choose a supported file.
diagnostic.INPUT_AMBIGUOUS: Several formats were detected. Assign the intended role explicitly.
diagnostic.INPUT_HINT_ONLY: Only the filename or MIME type suggests this format; structural validation is still required.
diagnostic.ROLE_REASSIGNED: The explicit role overrides detection. The selected interpretation will be validated.
diagnostic.ROLE_CONFLICT: Keep one input per role, except archives. Audio and video share one slot.
diagnostic.MISSING_HTML: An asset ZIP needs an HTML file. Add HTML or reassign the ZIP.
diagnostic.MINIMUM_FAMILIES: Choose at least two different supported format families.
diagnostic.IMPLEMENTATION_UNAVAILABLE: This capability is not implemented. Choose another input role.
diagnostic.INVALID_RANGE: An input byte range is invalid. Replace the file; report a recurring failure.
diagnostic.TRUNCATED_INPUT: The input is truncated. Choose a complete file.
diagnostic.OUTPUT_LIMIT: The result would exceed 2 GiB. Use smaller inputs.
diagnostic.IO_FAILURE: Reading or writing failed. Retry with smaller files; download diagnostics if it repeats.
diagnostic.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Temporary browser storage is unavailable. Check browser permissions or try another browser.
diagnostic.STORAGE_FULL: Temporary storage is full. Free space or use smaller files, then retry.
diagnostic.CLEANUP_FAILED: Temporary cleanup failed. Close this tab and reopen the app to retry cleanup.
diagnostic.CANCELLED: Operation cancelled. You can change the selection or retry.
diagnostic.JOB_BUSY: Another operation is active. Wait or cancel it.
diagnostic.WORKER_FAILED: Processing stopped unexpectedly. Retry and download diagnostics if it repeats.
diagnostic.WORKER_PROTOCOL: The processing worker returned an invalid response. Reload and retry.
diagnostic.HTML_UNRESOLVED: Some HTML references are unresolved. Supply the assets or explicitly continue unchanged.
diagnostic.HTML_ASSET_INVALID: An HTML/CSS asset is invalid or unsupported. Check its encoding and syntax.
diagnostic.HTML_ENCODING: HTML must use valid UTF-8 without NUL characters. Re-save the file as UTF-8.
diagnostic.FORMAT_RESOURCE_LIMIT: A metadata, parser, or work limit was exceeded. Use smaller or simpler inputs; see the source compatibility notes.
diagnostic.OFFSET_OVERFLOW: Container offsets cannot represent this result. Use smaller inputs.
diagnostic.COMBINATION_UNSUPPORTED: This combination has not been verified. Remove or reassign an input.
diagnostic.ARCHIVE_COLLISION: Later selected archives overwrite the listed matching paths. Reorder archives to change the winner.
diagnostic.ARCHIVE_EXPANDED_LIMIT: Expanded archive contents must remain below 1 GiB per archive and after merging. Use smaller archives.
diagnostic.ARCHIVE_PATH: Archive paths are unsafe or conflicting. Repack with ordinary relative paths.
diagnostic.AUDIO_DECODE_UNAVAILABLE: This browser cannot decode this audio. Update your browser or use a compatible AAC-LC MP4/M4A file.
diagnostic.AUDIO_CONVERSION_FAILED: Audio conversion failed. Try another supported audio file and download diagnostics if it repeats.
diagnostic.IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED: This image format or encoding is unsupported. Use a static PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or BMP.
diagnostic.IMAGE_ANIMATED: Animated images are unsupported. Choose a static image.
diagnostic.IMAGE_MULTIPAGE: Multipage images are unsupported. Choose a single static image.
diagnostic.IMAGE_INVALID: The image structure or decoded dimensions failed validation. It may be incomplete or use an unsupported encoding variant.
diagnostic.IMAGE_RESOURCE_LIMIT: The image exceeds the decoded-pixel or canvas-dimension limit. Resize it before selecting it.
diagnostic.IMAGE_DECODE_UNAVAILABLE: This browser cannot provide the image decoder or canvas needed for conversion. Try another current browser.
diagnostic.MP4_INVALID: MP4 structure, track metadata or payload offsets could not be validated. A fresh compatible export may work; report it if the file plays correctly elsewhere.
diagnostic.MP4_FRAGMENTED: Fragmented MP4 is unsupported. Use a classic non-fragmented MP4.
diagnostic.MP4_ENCRYPTED: Encrypted files are unsupported. Choose an unencrypted copy.
diagnostic.MP4_CODEC: Use H.264/AAC-LC in classic MP4, or supported MP3/PCM WAV/Ogg audio.
diagnostic.MP4_TRACKS: Use one H.264 video track with optional AAC-LC audio, or one compatible AAC-LC audio track. Extra or unsupported tracks cannot be retained.
diagnostic.MP4_STRUCTURE: This container structure is unsupported. See the compatibility notes and choose a compatible file.
diagnostic.PDF_INVALID: The PDF did not pass a structural check. This can also indicate a parser limitation; report it if the document opens correctly elsewhere.
diagnostic.PDF_STRUCTURE: This PDF layout is not supported by the current processor. The document may still be valid.
diagnostic.PDF_ENCRYPTED: Encrypted files are unsupported. Choose an unencrypted copy.
diagnostic.ARCHIVE_INVALID: The archive failed a structure or integrity check. Obtain a complete copy or recreate it; a report may help identify an unsupported variant.
diagnostic.ARCHIVE_UNSUPPORTED: This archive uses a feature outside the supported classic ZIP subset. Repack ordinary files with Store or Deflate compression.
diagnostic.ARCHIVE_ENCRYPTED: Encrypted files are unsupported. Choose an unencrypted copy.
diagnostic.ARCHIVE_SPLIT: This is a split or multi-disk archive. Combine its parts externally and repack it as a single supported ZIP.
diagnostic.AUDIO_INVALID: Audio structure, track data or duration could not be validated. The file may be incomplete or use an unsupported encoding variant.
diagnostic.AUDIO_CODEC: Use H.264/AAC-LC in classic MP4, or supported MP3/PCM WAV/Ogg audio.
diagnostic.AUDIO_TRACKS: Audio conversion requires exactly one audio track and no video tracks. Export the intended audio track separately.
diagnostic.AUDIO_CHANNELS: This AAC channel layout is unsupported. Use a supported explicit channel configuration.

pdfReason.HEADER: The PDF must begin with a PDF 1.0–1.7 or 2.0 header followed by a line break. Re-export the document as a PDF.
pdfReason.ENDING: The PDF's final startxref pointer and %%EOF marker could not be read. The file may be incomplete or have unsupported trailing data. Try a fresh export.
pdfReason.XREF_OFFSET: The PDF's startxref pointer falls outside its cross-reference area. Re-export the document to rebuild its offsets.
pdfReason.XREF_TABLE: No supported cross-reference structure was recognized at the PDF's declared offset. The layout may be unsupported or the pointer inconsistent. Report it if the PDF opens correctly elsewhere.
pdfReason.XREF_SUBSECTION: A PDF cross-reference subsection has an invalid header or range. Re-export the document to rebuild the table.
pdfReason.XREF_ENTRY: A PDF cross-reference entry has an invalid layout or generation number. Re-export the document to rebuild the table.
pdfReason.DUPLICATE_OBJECT: The PDF cross-reference table lists an object more than once. Re-export the document to rebuild the table.
pdfReason.OBJECT_OFFSET: A PDF cross-reference entry points outside the document's object area. Re-export the document to rebuild its offsets.
pdfReason.FREE_LIST: The PDF's free-object links or reserved generation are inconsistent. This check allows ordinary nonzero free-list links. Report it if the PDF opens correctly elsewhere.
pdfReason.ENCRYPTED: This PDF declares encryption. Export an unencrypted copy before combining it.
pdfReason.INCREMENTAL: The PDF contains earlier revisions linked by a Prev pointer. Incremental updates are unsupported. Try a full rewrite with a classic xref table.
pdfReason.HYBRID: The PDF combines a classic table with a cross-reference stream. Hybrid cross-references are unsupported. Try a classic-table-only export.
pdfReason.TRAILER: The PDF's trailer syntax could not be processed. This may be a parser limitation rather than a damaged document. Report it if the PDF opens correctly elsewhere.
pdfReason.TRAILER_FIELDS: The PDF trailer contains duplicate or inconsistent fields. Report it if the PDF opens correctly elsewhere.
pdfReason.ROOT: The PDF trailer's Size or Root does not match its cross-reference entries. Re-export the document to rebuild its structure.
pdfReason.OBJECT_HEADER: An object at a PDF cross-reference offset does not match its declared number and generation. Re-export the document to rebuild its offsets.
pdfReason.METADATA_LIMIT: The PDF's cross-reference and trailer area needs {{actual}}; the metadata limit is {{limit}}. Try an export with fewer objects.
pdfReason.ENTRY_LIMIT: The PDF cross-reference table declares {{actual}} records; the limit is {{limit}}. Try an export with fewer objects.
pdfReason.LINEARIZED: This PDF uses a linearized layout for fast web viewing. Relocating its linked tables and hints is not supported yet. A non-linearized classic-table export may work.
pdfReason.XREF_STREAM: This PDF stores its cross-references in a stream. That valid PDF layout is not supported yet. A classic-table export may work.

detail.FORMAT_RECORDS: The {{format}} inspector reached {{actual}} structural records; the limit is {{limit}}. Use a simpler input.
detail.MEDIA_METADATA_BYTES: A media metadata block or packet needs {{actual}}; its allocation limit is {{limit}}. Use a compatible export with smaller metadata blocks.
detail.VIDEO_TRACKS: The MP4 contains {{tracks}} tracks. Use one H.264 video track with optional AAC-LC audio, or one compatible AAC-LC audio track.
detail.MEDIA_CONTAINER: The detected {{format}} container is unsupported. Video requires a compatible MP4; audio also accepts supported MP3, WAV and Ogg.
detail.SELECTED_INPUTS: {{actual}} files selected; the maximum is {{limit}}, including the HTML asset ZIP. Remove some files.
detail.INPUT_BYTES: This input is {{actual}}; the maximum per file is {{limit}}. Choose a smaller file.
detail.TOTAL_BYTES: Selected inputs total {{actual}}; the maximum is {{limit}}. Remove or replace files.
detail.IMAGE_DIMENSIONS: Image dimensions are {{width}} × {{height}}. Each dimension must be at most {{limit}} pixels.
detail.IMAGE_PIXELS: The {{width}} × {{height}} image has {{actual}} pixels; the maximum is {{limit}}. Resize it before selecting it.
detail.IMAGE_FORMAT: The detected {{format}} image format is not supported. Use a static PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or BMP.
detail.ZIP_DIRECTORY_BYTES: Archive indexes need {{actual}}; their shared metadata limit is {{limit}}. Use fewer or simpler archives.
detail.ZIP_ENTRIES: Archive indexes declare {{actual}} entries; the shared limit is {{limit}}, including HTML assets.
detail.ZIP_OUTPUT_ENTRIES: The merged archive needs {{actual}} entries; classic ZIP output supports at most {{limit}}. Reduce the entry count.
detail.ZIP_FILENAME_BYTES: An archive path uses {{actual}} UTF-8 bytes; the maximum is {{limit}}. Shorten the path before repacking.
detail.ZIP64: This archive requires ZIP64, which the current archive pipeline does not support. Repack as a classic ZIP if its size and entry count allow it.
detail.ZIP_SYMLINK: The archive contains a symbolic link. Repack it with ordinary files and directories.
detail.ZIP_COMPRESSION: ZIP compression method {{actual}} is unsupported. Repack using Store (0) or Deflate (8).
detail.ZIP_CRC: An extracted entry failed its CRC integrity check. Obtain a complete copy or recreate the archive.
detail.ZIP_SIZE_CHECK: An entry's expanded size failed the archive integrity check. Obtain a complete copy or recreate the archive.
detail.ZIP_PATH_ABSOLUTE: An archive entry uses an absolute or drive-qualified path. Repack with relative paths.
detail.ZIP_PATH_TRAVERSAL: An archive path is empty or contains unsafe segments or control characters. Repack with ordinary relative paths.
detail.ZIP_PATH_CONFLICT: An archive path is used both as a file and as a parent folder. Rename the conflicting entry before repacking.
detail.ZIP_HEADER: The archive's directory or end record does not match its declared layout. The archive may be incomplete or use an unsupported variant.
detail.ZIP_ENTRY_SIZE: An entry produced {{actual}} bytes but declared {{limit}}. The archive failed its integrity check.
detail.ZIP_EXPANDED_BYTES: Expanded contents reach {{actual}}; each archive and the merged result must remain below {{limit}}.
detail.HTML_LOGICAL_BYTES: HTML plus all expanded asset ZIP contents total {{actual}}; their shared allowance is {{limit}}.
detail.HTML_OUTPUT_BYTES: Standalone HTML needs {{actual}}, including base64 expansion; the maximum is {{limit}}. Use smaller assets.
detail.HTML_TEXT_BYTES: An HTML or CSS document needs {{actual}} of parsed text; the limit is {{limit}}. Binary assets have a separate streaming path.
detail.HTML_NODES: HTML processing reached {{actual}} nodes; the limit is {{limit}}. Simplify the document.
detail.HTML_REFERENCES: HTML/CSS processing reached {{actual}} references; the limit is {{limit}}. Reduce repeated resource references.
detail.CSS_SYNTAX: A stylesheet could not be parsed as supported CSS. Check its syntax; it may also use a construct the bundler does not support.
detail.ASSET_ENCODING: A text asset is not valid UTF-8. Save the HTML, stylesheet or script as UTF-8 before repacking.
detail.ASSET_DIRECTORY: A resource reference points to a directory instead of a file. Correct the reference or the ZIP contents.
detail.ASSET_RECIPE: HTML asset serialization could not be completed. Retry and report a recurring failure.
detail.MEDIA_CODEC: The detected {{codec}} codec or its configuration is unsupported here. Video requires H.264 with optional AAC-LC; audio conversion accepts supported MP3, WAV and Ogg codecs.
detail.MEDIA_TRACKS: The audio input contains {{tracks}} tracks, including {{audioTracks}} audio tracks. Use one audio track with no separate video track.
detail.MEDIA_SAMPLE_RATE: Audio sample rate {{actual}} Hz is unsupported. Use a rate between 7,350 and 192,000 Hz.
detail.MEDIA_CHANNELS: This audio has {{actual}} channels. Supported counts are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8.
detail.MEDIA_BRAND: This MP4 major brand is outside the supported classic MP4 subset. A standard H.264/AAC-LC MP4 export may work.
detail.MEDIA_BOX: The container uses an unsupported {{feature}} box or layout. Export a self-contained, non-fragmented H.264/AAC-LC MP4.
detail.MEDIA_EXTERNAL: This media references data outside the selected file. Export a self-contained MP4.
detail.MEDIA_TIMING: Media timing metadata is missing, inconsistent or unsupported. Try a fresh compatible MP4 export.
detail.MEDIA_SAMPLES: Media sample sizes or offsets are inconsistent with the encoded payload. Try a fresh compatible MP4 export.
detail.MEDIA_BOXES: Media metadata contains {{actual}} boxes; the inspection limit is {{limit}}.
detail.AUDIO_DURATION: A valid positive audio duration could not be determined. The file may be incomplete or use an unsupported structure.
detail.AUDIO_PACKETS: Audio conversion needs {{actual}} AAC packets; the limit is {{limit}}. Use a shorter recording.
detail.AUDIO_OUTPUT_BYTES: Estimated converted audio needs {{actual}}; the maximum output allowance is {{limit}}.
detail.AUDIO_DECODE: This browser cannot decode the detected {{codec}} audio with the available pipeline. MP3 has a local fallback; other codecs require native decoding. A compatible AAC-LC M4A can avoid conversion.
detail.WORKSPACE_BYTES: The job needs {{actual}} of live temporary files; its workspace limit is {{limit}}. Use smaller inputs.
